description:
Job Title: ZT STS Software Engineer-TS/SCI with Poly 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: None 
 
Type of Travel: None 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity: 
 The DevOps Systems Engineer will contribute to the Zero Trust Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ZT ICAM) program, supporting solution deployments for Department of Defense customers. Working under the guidance of senior engineering staff, this role will participate in automated build, test, packaging, deployment, monitoring, and release operations; provide support for Linux and containerized environments; and help sustain consistent deployment configurations along with associated technical documentation. The ideal candidate brings foundational DevOps knowledge and hands‑on exposure to Kubernetes, with a strong motivation to expand these skills while contributing to an integrated enterprise solution used across diverse customer environments.
   
 Responsibilities: 
 This position is for a Software Engineer to support mission-critical web service development in support of an Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) solution. 
 Technical responsibilities include support for AWS cloud-native software design, development, integration, testing, and operational maintenance of highly available, enterprise level services. 

 Qualifications: 

 Required: 
 Active TS/SCI clearance with polygraph.
 Bachelor's Degree or higher in computer engineering or in a field related to the computer engineering or computer science disciplines is required. 
 5+ years of software engineering experience is required. 2+ years’ work experience in the SIGINT, IA, or IT domains is required. 
 4 years of software engineering experience may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree, for a total of 9 years.
   
 Desired: 
 Experience with AWS native development including Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, as well as IAM roles/permissions/SCPs.  
 High level of proficiency and skill with Java & Javascript software development
 Experience with TerraForm and/or infrastructure-as-code.
 Familiar with Linux environments
 Skilled at building robust, scalable, secure, and high-performance applications
 Ability to write unit test cases using Junit/Mock testing frameworks
 Experienced with automated builds using Gitlab Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
 PKI encryption and authenticationExperience with Docker/Kubernetes
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$94,400 - $198,200 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
